I wrote the agent brief at `AGENT_PROMPT_TYPOGRAPHIC_PORTFOLIO.md` on a new branch, `design/typographic-portfolio`. It tells the agent to throw out the current design and rebuild the portfolio around typography, with interactive type, scroll animation and at least one 3D moment. The agent will run all commands without asking, using Impeccable, the taste skill and Emil Kowalski's skills.

**What the brief covers:**
- **What gets scrapped:** every current component, the 3D ribbon hero, the portrait hero, the "What I Do" list, the quote and the tech-stack logo grid. Both earlier looks you've tried are banned: "Signal Film" (dark with acid lime) and "Atelier Cobalt" (pale paper, cobalt blue, Manrope).
- **What stays:** only the facts in `src/lib/content.ts`. Experience, Education and Projects are named as the sections that must be strongest. The agent can't invent claims.
- **Typography:** one expressive display font (ideally variable, so its weight and width can animate), very large headlines next to small detail text, and banned default fonts like Inter and Manrope.
- **Interaction and 3D:** cursor- and scroll-driven type, scroll-revealed headlines, project titles rendered in 3D, screenshots revealed on hover, and a transition where the clicked project title becomes the detail page heading. It also sets performance and accessibility rules.
- **Process:** the agent proposes three typographic concepts and picks one. Then it builds, refines with the skills, checks lint, the build and desktop/mobile screenshots, and updates `DESIGN.md` and `PRODUCT.md`.

**Inspiration I researched and cited in the brief:**
- [Mat Voyce](https://matvoyce.tv): the whole interface is moving type.
- [Corentin Bernadou](https://tympanus.net/codrops/2026/03/05/inside-corentin-bernadous-portfolio-swiss-inspired-layouts-webgl-geometry-and-thoughtful-motion/): Swiss poster layouts with an interactive grid.
- [Run Rob Run](https://www.awwwards.com/sites/run-rob-run): scroll-paced type with a 3D scene that reacts.
- [Joseph Santamaria](https://tympanus.net/codrops/2026/04/28/more-than-a-portfolio-building-a-scroll-driven-3d-world-with-something-to-say/): type placed inside a 3D world.
- [Dennis Snellenberg](https://dennissnellenberg.com): a huge name that runs off the page.
- [Magnet Type](https://magnettype.com/) and [CrazyGL](https://crazygl.com/): letters that change weight and width near the cursor.

The brief tells the agent to borrow techniques from these sites, not copy their looks.

**Uncommitted work:** nothing is committed yet. The current Next.js code was never committed on `design/atelier-cobalt`, so it carried over into this branch as it was. The brief tells the agent to delete those components, so commit them on `design/atelier-cobalt` first if you want to keep a copy of that version.

To start, open a new agent chat on this branch and say: "Read and execute `AGENT_PROMPT_TYPOGRAPHIC_PORTFOLIO.md`."

**What works for cloud agents**

Skills must be **committed under the repo** (usually `.agents/skills/`) and **pushed** on the branch the cloud agent uses. Global `npx skills add … -g` only helps local Cursor.

The old cloud chat won’t pick them up. Start a **new** cloud agent on the branch that has the skills.

1. Open **Cloud / Background Agents** in Cursor.
2. Choose repo `Jiin-dom/portfolio`.
3. Set branch to **`design/typographic-portfolio`** (not `main`).
4. Start a **new** agent (don’t reuse the old `bc-fc6a8cee…` run).
5. In the prompt, say something like:

```text
Read and execute AGENT_PROMPT_TYPOGRAPHIC_PORTFOLIO.md.

Skills are already in this repo under .agents/skills/ — use impeccable, design-taste-frontend, emil-design-eng, and animate from there. Do not rely on global installs.
```

That’s it. Skills only load from what’s on the branch at clone time, so a new run on `design/typographic-portfolio` is what makes them show up.
